## Purpose

Per-cancer Cox survival analysis of age-matched **Deviation**
(GTEx-anchored, in years) against OS and PFI endpoints from the
TCGA integrated clinical file (CDR-like). Deviation is loaded
directly from the saved ClockSHAP object (the ClockSHAP step output), not
recomputed.

Outputs a single per-cancer RDS at:

  `<proc_dir>/survival_deviation_results-<feature_set>.rds`

containing both endpoints' Cox results in a tidy table format
suitable for downstream cross-cancer aggregation.

## Load inputs

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(survival)
  library(broom)
  library(scales)
})
```

```{r}
reactable_pretty <- function(df, digits = 3) {
  if (!requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)) return(df)
  df2 <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., digits)))
  reactable::reactable(
    df2,
    searchable = TRUE,
    resizable  = TRUE,
    striped    = TRUE,
    highlight  = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 10
  )
}
```

```{r}
analysis_id <- paste0(params$tcga_project, "__", params$gtex_project)
proc_dir <- file.path(here::here(params$out_root), analysis_id)
suffix   <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)

msg <- function(...) if (isTRUE(params$verbose)) message(...)
msg("proc_dir = ", proc_dir)
```

## Load Deviation from saved ClockSHAP object

```{r}
clockshap_path <- file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clockshap_objects", suffix, ".rds"))
metadata_path  <- file.path(proc_dir, "sample_metadata.rds")

stopifnot(file.exists(clockshap_path))
stopifnot(file.exists(metadata_path))

cs       <- readRDS(clockshap_path)
metadata <- readRDS(metadata_path)

stopifnot(!is.null(cs$pt))
stopifnot(!is.null(cs$pt$deviation))
stopifnot(!is.null(cs$pt$age))

# Sanity check: ClockSHAP invariant phi-row-sums == deviation
phi_row_sums <- rowSums(cs$pt$phi)
max_abs_err  <- max(abs(phi_row_sums - cs$pt$deviation), na.rm = TRUE)
msg("ClockSHAP invariant max |sum(phi) - deviation|: ", signif(max_abs_err, 3))

# Build the per-tumor deviation table
dev_df <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = rownames(cs$pt$phi),
  age_years = as.numeric(cs$pt$age),
  Deviation = as.numeric(cs$pt$deviation)
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(age_years), is.finite(Deviation))

msg("Tumor samples with deviation: ", nrow(dev_df))
```

## Helpers

```{r}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

# 12-char patient barcode lookup from metadata
get_patient12 <- function(sample_ids, metadata) {
  if ("tcga.tcga_barcode" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    out <- substr(as.character(metadata[sample_ids, "tcga.tcga_barcode"]), 1, 12)
    out[out == "" | is.na(out)] <- NA_character_
    return(out)
  }
  if ("tcga.cgc_case_id" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    x <- as.character(metadata[sample_ids, "tcga.cgc_case_id"])
    out <- substr(x, 1, 12)
    out[out == "" | is.na(out)] <- NA_character_
    return(out)
  }
  # Fall back to sample_id if it looks like a TCGA barcode
  out <- ifelse(grepl("^TCGA-", sample_ids), substr(sample_ids, 1, 12), NA_character_)
  out[out == "" | is.na(out)] <- NA_character_
  out
}

# Endpoint column discovery for TCGA IntegratedClinical.csv (CDR-like)
pick_surv_cols <- function(cdr, endpoint = c("OS", "PFI")) {
  endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
  if (endpoint == "OS") {
    time_candidates  <- c("OS.time", "OS_time", "OS.time.days", "OS_days", "OS_time_days")
    event_candidates <- c("OS", "OS_event", "OS.status", "OS_status")
  } else {
    time_candidates  <- c("PFI.time", "PFI_time", "PFI.time.days", "PFI_days", "PFI_time_days")
    event_candidates <- c("PFI", "PFI_event", "PFI.status", "PFI_status")
  }
  list(
    time_col  = intersect(time_candidates,  colnames(cdr))[1],
    event_col = intersect(event_candidates, colnames(cdr))[1]
  )
}
```

## Merge clinical + run Cox per endpoint

`Surv(time, event) ~ age_years + Deviation` per endpoint. No per-cancer
extra covariates — keeping the model simple and identical across
cancers maximizes cross-cancer comparability for downstream aggregation.

```{r}
surv_os_res  <- NULL
surv_pfi_res <- NULL

if (is.null(params$clinical_csv) || !file.exists(params$clinical_csv)) {
  warning("clinical_csv not found: ", params$clinical_csv, " (skipping survival analysis)")
} else {

  cdr <- read.csv(
    params$clinical_csv,
    na.strings = c("NA", "", "#N/A"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = TRUE
  )

  if (!"bcr_patient_barcode" %in% colnames(cdr)) {
    warning("Integrated clinical file missing bcr_patient_barcode column; cannot merge (skipping survival analysis).")
  } else {

    # Build patient barcode for tumors
    dev_df2 <- dev_df %>%
      mutate(patient12 = get_patient12(sample_id, metadata)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(patient12))
    msg("Tumor samples with patient12: ", nrow(dev_df2), "/", nrow(dev_df))

    # One row per patient in clinical file
    cdr2 <- cdr %>%
      mutate(patient12 = substr(as.character(bcr_patient_barcode), 1, 12)) %>%
      distinct(patient12, .keep_all = TRUE)

    # Merge
    surv_base <- dev_df2 %>%
      left_join(cdr2, by = "patient12") %>%
      filter(is.finite(Deviation), is.finite(age_years))

    run_one_survival <- function(endpoint = c("OS", "PFI")) {
      endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
      cols <- pick_surv_cols(surv_base, endpoint)

      if (is.na(cols$time_col) || is.na(cols$event_col)) {
        warning("Could not find required columns for ", endpoint, " in clinical file (skipping).")
        return(NULL)
      }

      df <- surv_base %>%
        mutate(
          time  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[cols$time_col]])),
          event = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[cols$event_col]]))
        ) %>%
        mutate(event = event == 1) %>%
        filter(is.finite(time), !is.na(event))

      msg(endpoint, " rows n=", nrow(df), " | events=", sum(df$event))

      if (sum(df$event) < params$min_events) {
        warning("Not enough ", endpoint, " events (", sum(df$event), " < min_events=", params$min_events, "); skipping Cox model.")
        return(NULL)
      }

      fml <- as.formula("Surv(time, event) ~ age_years + Deviation")
      cox_fit <- coxph(fml, data = df)
      s <- summary(cox_fit)

      rr <- s$coefficients["Deviation", "coef"]
      se <- s$coefficients["Deviation", "se(coef)"]
      p  <- s$coefficients["Deviation", "Pr(>|z|)"]

      hr <- exp(rr)
      ci <- exp(rr + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se)

      # Proportional hazards diagnostic (per-coefficient + global)
      zph <- tryCatch(cox.zph(cox_fit), error = function(e) NULL)
      zph_dev_p    <- if (!is.null(zph) && "Deviation" %in% rownames(zph$table)) zph$table["Deviation", "p"] else NA_real_
      zph_global_p <- if (!is.null(zph)) zph$table["GLOBAL", "p"] else NA_real_

      tibble(
        analysis_id    = analysis_id,
        endpoint       = endpoint,
        n              = nrow(df),
        events         = sum(df$event),
        model          = deparse(fml),
        HR_per1yr_dev  = hr,
        CI_low         = ci[1],
        CI_high        = ci[2],
        p_value        = p,
        zph_dev_p      = zph_dev_p,
        zph_global_p   = zph_global_p
      )
    }

    surv_os_res  <- run_one_survival("OS")
    surv_pfi_res <- run_one_survival("PFI")
  }
}
```

## Save per-cancer results

```{r}
out_rds <- list(
  analysis_id  = analysis_id,
  surv_res_os  = surv_os_res,
  surv_res_pfi = surv_pfi_res
)

out_path <- file.path(proc_dir, paste0("survival_deviation_results", suffix, ".rds"))
saveRDS(out_rds, file = out_path)
msg("Saved: ", out_path)
```

## Summary table + forest plot (OS + PFI)

```{r}
tbl_surv <- bind_rows(surv_os_res, surv_pfi_res)

if (nrow(tbl_surv) == 0) {
  msg("No survival results available to summarize (OS and PFI both NULL).")
} else {

  tbl_print <- tbl_surv %>%
    mutate(
      endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = c("OS", "PFI")),
      HR       = as.numeric(HR_per1yr_dev),
      CI       = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", CI_low), "–", sprintf("%.2f", CI_high)),
      p_value  = as.numeric(p_value)
    ) %>%
    select(endpoint, n, events, HR, CI_low, CI_high, p_value, zph_dev_p, zph_global_p)

  reactable_pretty(tbl_print)
}
```

```{r}
if (nrow(tbl_surv) > 0) {

  forest_df <- tbl_surv %>%
    mutate(
      HR    = HR_per1yr_dev,
      label = paste0(endpoint, " (n=", n, ", events=", events, ")"),
      sig   = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05")
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(label)))

  forest_plot <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(x = HR, y = label)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), height = 0.2) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_log10(
      breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("p < 0.05" = 19, "p ≥ 0.05" = 1), name = "Significance") +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Effect of tumor Deviation on survival: ", analysis_id),
      subtitle = "Cox HR per +1 year of GTEx-anchored Deviation (age-adjusted)",
      x = "Hazard ratio (log scale)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

  forest_plot
}
```
